design_code_docs_agreement.regular_file: Agrees. Design Decision 14, How the config file is found, Defaults and overrides row, Security note item 10: a ./warden.toml found by default that is not a regular file once links are followed is the error 'not a regular file' and is not opened; a link to nothing is no file; a named file is read whatever kind. Code: readConfigFile (cmd/warden/config.go:175-220) applies errNotRegular only when source == configFromDir, after os.Stat (follows links); configFile treats ErrNotExist (dangling link) as no file. Reference configuration.md:28-34 and overview.md:32-35 say the same.
design_code_docs_agreement.cap: Agrees. Design: read in 65536-byte blocks, stop once more than 1048576 bytes arrived (at most 1114112 read), error 'larger than 1 MiB' with the fix 'make it 1 MiB or smaller, or name it with --config or WARDEN_CONFIG, which reads it whatever its size'; a read error before the cap is the OS's error with the unreadable-file text; a named file is unbounded. Code: maxProjectConfig = 1<<20, configBlock = 1<<16, readCapped (config.go:252-267) appends each block and returns errTooLarge when len(data) > cap, so at most cap+block is read; other errors returned unchanged and wrapped by unreadableConfig; named sources use os.ReadFile. Reference says 'read up to 1 MiB ... larger than 1 MiB ... read whole'. Tests (configfile_test.go) cover exactly 1 MiB, 1 MiB + 1, /proc/self/pagemap, /proc/self/mem (EIO), endless readers bounded at cap+block, a reader failing before the cap, and named over-cap files under --config and WARDEN_CONFIG, as the Validation plan lists. The verifier's runtime matrix under all six config-reading commands matches.

A security-boundary change: trust roots sent across host-relay as re-encoded valid PEM only, the user-level config file removed, ModuleRoot found from the executable only; the delta adds how the default config file is read (regular-file check and 1 MiB cap). The design carries the Security note the rule asks for, updated at r2/r3 (What remains, 10).
findings.fix: No code change. The human acknowledges at merge with the Security note in the PR body; TEST-08's adversarial arm runs before the release that carries it.

judged_not_findings: The fix line for 'not a regular file' is 'make it readable, or name another file ...', the unreadable-file fix; the design's example (design lines ~993-995) gives that text, so it matches.

Stat-then-open window in readConfigFile: a ./warden.toml swapped for a FIFO after os.Stat would block os.Open. Needs a concurrent writer on the host, outside the design's static-repository model; no rule covers it. Opening first and checking the opened file (f.Stat, or O_NONBLOCK) would close it; noted for the human, not a finding.

driver/detach.go passes the parent's config path to the background image prepare as --config (Decision 10, approved): when the parent read the default ./warden.toml, the child reads the same path as a named file, unbounded and without the regular-file check. Only matters if the file is replaced between the two reads; same race-only class. Noted for the human.

GLOBAL-10/11: the cap is not a fallback (the design says so under Defaults and overrides): over the cap is an error, not a partial read and not another source. No new default or merge outside the section.
